inputs.share_count_basis: 249,250,945 shares in issue at 30-Jun-2026 less 1,796,700 treasury shares (H1 FY2026 interim note 14) = 247.454m. Diluted EPS weighted count equals basic (248.367m) post-IPO conversion of the preferred shares, so no further dilutive securities are material. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows.
inputs.cash_note: 30-Jun-2026: cash & equivalents 978.1 + time deposits >3m current 2,024.5 + non-current 130.0 + cash-management products at FVTPL 10.3 = 3,142.9 RMBm. Pledged deposits (45.8, securing notes payable) excluded as restricted. No borrowings in any period.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 total interest income. Only ~64.2 of it sits inside OCF (8.5 on >3m time deposits is classified in investing), so deducting the full 72.8 over-deducts ~8.5 on the anchor; immaterial and conservative. Forward flows are built from EBITDA ex interest income, so the projection is clean.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual cash flow statement add-back 'Share-based payment expenses' RMB41,203k (0325.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:11081); no equity-award withholding taxes (EquityAwardTaxes = 0). FY2024's 407.3m was an IPO-related one-off (366.5m of it a single pre-IPO grant charge) and is not used as the forward anchor; H1 FY2026 was 13.7m (0.8% of revenue).
inputs.buyback_note: Actual repurchases: FY2025 RMB59.6m (704,100 shares), H1 FY2026 RMB50.8m (1,092,600 shares). The company is a modest repurchaser, so the flat count is roughly funded.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1721 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-10T03:38Z). Direction: HKD per 1 CNY; model values in RMB are multiplied by 1.1721 to give the HKD figures compared with the HKEX price. Parity check: the H1 FY2026 interim converts the RMB50,760k buyback to ~HK$58,228k incl. fees (1.147, an H1-average rate); the spot rate is 2% above that, consistent with continued CNY strength since. No dual listing to cross-check.
inputs.wacc_rationale: RMB flows, all-equity (no debt). China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta ~1.2 x China ERP ~6.5% = ~9.6%, rounded to 10.0% for a single-product-line consumer toy company with a short history as a profitable business. Risk is charged in the scenario flows and weights; WACC is identical across scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: lease payments (FY2025 37.2m, H1 FY2026 12.7m) charged via lease_cost_pct_path inside EBIT; lease liabilities (20.1m at 30-Jun-2026) EXCLUDED from net debt; da_pct_path is ex right-of-use depreciation. Leases are immaterial (<1% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: None. NCI was nil from FY2025 (prior small NCI of 3.0m in FY2024 was bought out in the reorganisation).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted, per dcf-methods routing for a non-US consumer operating company (assembly character toys under licensed IP: Ultraman, Transformers, Marvel, etc.). First valuation, no prior DCF or memory entry. FY0 = FY2025 (31-Dec year end); year 1 = FY2026, whose growth is anchored to H1 FY2026 actual (+32.7% revenue, adj. EBITDA margin ~32.5%). Adj. EBITDA here is pre-SBC, ex interest income and pre-IFRS16 lease charge: FY2025 = PBT 693.5 + D&A 198.2 + finance cost 1.7 - interest income 72.8 + SBC 41.2 = 861.9 (29.6% of revenue); H1 FY2026 ~584 (32.9%) incl. a 7.1m PPE impairment add-back. Non-operating fair-value losses on the convertible preferred shares (FY2023 274.1m, FY2024 542.0m) are excluded; they ended at the Jan-2025 IPO conversion. Capex includes purchases of intangibles (molds, IP licence/design assets): FY2025 PPE 234.6 + intangibles 113.1 = 347.7 (11.9%); H1 FY2026 189.0 (10.6%). Cash tax: FY2025 cash tax paid 48.3m on PBT 693.5 (7%), H1 FY2026 39.1m on 430.9 (9%); preferential (HNTE-type) rates plus R&D super-deduction and tax-loss deferred tax assets of 157.7m; ramped toward 17%. Working capital ~neutral: payables growth has funded inventory and receivables (FY2025 net WC +14m, H1 FY2026 +22m), so capture held at 0. Short operating history as a profitable company (losses FY2021-24 before the IPO-related charges) argues for a front-loaded explicit growth phase and a wide bull/bear spread rather than a long steady-state assumption.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY2026 growth anchored to the H1 FY2026 run-rate (+32.7% H1, H2 assumed ~+20%); equity and EPS CAGRs are undefined (negative equity FY2021-24 from the preferred-share liability, losses through FY2024)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity and EPS CAGRs cannot be computed (negative bases); revenue 3yr CAGR of 107.5% is a post-Ultraman-launch ramp that cannot be extrapolated. Selected rate is a judgment, not a historical CAGR.
historical_growth.notes: History is thin: full statements only FY2023-FY2025 (+H1s); FY2021-22 are summary rows from the FY2024 five-year table. Owner FCF: FY2023 235.3 (241.6 - 6.2 SBC), FY2024 228.8 (641.8 - 407.3 SBC - 5.8 interest), FY2025 435.3 (549.2 - 41.2 - 72.8). The owner-FCF 2yr CAGR (36.0%) is below reported (50.8%) only because of the one-off FY2024 IPO grant and the post-IPO interest income on the cash pile, not because SBC is structurally outgrowing cash flow: SBC fell from 1.4% of revenue in FY2025 to 0.8% in H1 FY2026.

base.narrative: H1 FY2026 momentum carries FY2026 to ~RMB3.6bn; growth then decelerates as the Ultraman franchise matures and newer IPs and overseas only partly offset it. Margins drift down from the H1 FY2026 peak as gross margin keeps compressing (48.4% -> 44.3% H1 YoY) from lower price points, overseas mix and licensor royalties.

bull.narrative: Bloks becomes a multi-IP platform rather than an Ultraman proxy: adult-fan lines and owned series (TERRAVENTURE, DaaLaMode) scale, overseas channels compound, and operating leverage holds the margin near the H1 FY2026 level.

bear.narrative: The collectible-toy cycle turns: H2 FY2026 slows sharply, Ultraman demand fades or the licence renews on worse terms, competitors (Keeppley, Pop Mart, Qman) take share at low price points, and revenue shrinks for two years before stabilising. Margins compress toward a normal licensed-toy level (~18% EBITDA).

scenario_narratives.base: Revenue ~RMB3.6bn in FY2026 on the H1 run-rate, then decelerating growth (17% -> 3%) as Ultraman matures and Transformers, Marvel, owned series and overseas partially replace it. Adj. EBITDA margin eases from 30.5% to 27% as the gross-margin compression already visible in H1 FY2026 (44.3% vs 48.4%) continues from lower-price-point products and licensor royalties, partly offset by scale. Capex (moulds and capitalised IP/design assets) normalises from ~11% to 8% of revenue; cash tax ramps from ~10% to 17%.
scenario_narratives.bull: The IP matrix broadens: adult-fan lines and owned IPs scale, overseas channels compound and Bloks sustains ~20%+ growth for four years, reaching ~RMB10bn+ revenue by year 10 with margins held near 30-32%. This needs several independent things to go right (new IP hits, overseas success, licence renewals on current terms).
scenario_narratives.bear: Kids' collectible demand is faddish and Bloks is concentrated in a handful of licensed IPs led by Ultraman. In the bear case the cycle turns after H1 FY2026: growth stalls in FY2027, revenue falls 6% and 3% in FY2028-29, low-price competition and licensor terms push EBITDA margin to ~18%, and the business settles as a mid-sized licensed-toy maker growing 2%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default: revenue depends heavily on a few licensed IPs (Ultraman above all) in a faddish category, the company has only ~2 years of profitable history, and gross margin is already compressing. Base held at 50%. Bull cut to 20% because it needs new IP hits, overseas success and licence renewals to all come through.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A net-cash, fast-growing licensed-IP toy maker valued on owner FCF (SBC expensed, interest income on the RMB3.1bn cash pile stripped and the cash added back once). The front-loaded growth phase and wide bear/bull spread reflect a business whose current profitability is about two years old and whose revenue is concentrated in a handful of licensed franchises.
key_risks_to_valuation: IP licence concentration (Ultraman) and renewal terms with licensors
Fad risk in kids' collectibles; the H1 FY2026 growth rate may not survive H2
Gross margin compression (48.4% -> 44.3% H1 YoY) from price-point mix and royalties
Short profitable history: losses through FY2024, IPO in Jan-2025
CNY/HKD rate: the valuation is in RMB and converted at spot; refresh_price.py does not update fx_rate
